scope: Prebuild compatibility between historical v316 validation and promoted v322 30,000-word Posts/Pages authority

build.rootCause: v316 validator required the historical 5,000-word source marker even after v322 promoted the same guard to 30,000 words

validationNote: The historical v316 release manifest and tests still describe the original 5,000-word release. When current source already carries the explicit v322 release marker, the v316 prebuild validator now accepts the promoted 30,000/27,000 values instead of aborting the build.
